page_title: RSO 0-2 MAL | Real Sociedad v Mallorca 12/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Jose Munuera has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
90+5' The attendance is 29181.

90+5' Arkaitz Mariezkurrena (Real Sociedad) fires the ball towards goal from just outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar after coming very close to hitting the roof of the net. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
90+2' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Aritz Elustondo (Real Sociedad) was quite harsh and Jose Munuera didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
90' A player from Mallorca brings down an opponent and commits a foul. Real Sociedad win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
88' A clumsy foul by Mateu Morey Bauza (Mallorca) and Jose Munuera blows his whistle. Real Sociedad will take a free kick.
85' The manager makes a subsitution with Mateu Morey Bauza (Mallorca) coming on for Antonio Sanchez.
84' Here is a change. Johan Mojica is going off and Jagoba Arrasate gives the last tactical orders to Toni Lato (Mallorca).
83' One of the Mallorca players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul.
79' Today's match ends for Cyle Larin who will be replaced by Abdon Prats (Mallorca).
74' Arkaitz Mariezkurrena (Real Sociedad) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
72' Substitution. Pablo Marin makes way for Jon Ander Olasagasti (Real Sociedad).
72' Imanol Alguacil decides to make a substitution. Takefusa Kubo will be replaced by Arkaitz Mariezkurrena (Real Sociedad).
72' It will be a substitution. Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) is ready to enter the pitch as Daniel Rodriguez walks off.
71' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) is cautioned by the referee.
70' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
70' Jon Martin (Real Sociedad) rises highest from the corner and heads at goal, but his effort towards the top left corner is saved by Dominik Greif.
70' Corner kick. Real Sociedad will have an opportunity.
67' A player from Real Sociedad takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
65' Real Sociedad take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
64' Real Sociedad have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
62' Mallorca can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
61' Jose Munuera blows his whistle for a foul after Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) hacks down one of his opponents. That's a free kick to Mallorca.
57' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
56' A cross from a corner kick by Real Sociedad is too strong and the ball goes well out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
56' The substitution has been made. Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) has replaced Luka Sucic.
55' Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
54' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent. Real Sociedad have a free kick.
49' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Jose Munuera blows his whistle for a foul.
47' 0 - 2 Sergi Darder (Mallorca) doesn't hesitate to lash home from just outside the box. Although the shot low to the middle of the goal isn't very precise, it ends up in the net.
46' Imanol Alguacil has decided to make a change. Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) replaces Ander Barrenetxea.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' The free kick picks out Martin Valjent (Mallorca) in space, but his close-range header flies miles past the right post.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' It seemed like Johan Mojica (Mallorca) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
45' One of the Real Sociedad players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul. Mallorca get a free kick.
42' Jose Munuera interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad). There is a free kick near the sideline to Mallorca.
41' A player from Mallorca pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle. Real Sociedad have a free kick.
38' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
32' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Sociedad.
30' The free kick picks out Jon Martin (Real Sociedad) in space, but his close-range header flies miles over the bar.
30' It seemed like Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
29' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jose Munuera no option but to blow his whistle.

26' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) bends the ball in from the edge of the box which worries the keeper, but it eventually sails just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
24' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
23' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) unleashes a rocket of a shot towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.
23' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Real Sociedad comes to nothing.

23' Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the bottom left corner is, however, superbly saved by Dominik Greif! Now Real Sociedad have a corner.
20' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Cyle Larin (Mallorca) receives a precise pass inside the box from Sergi Darder and he beats the goalkeeper with a neat finish into the bottom right corner.
16' Jon Martin (Real Sociedad) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes way over the bar.
14' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) makes a rough challenge and Jose Munuera blows his whistle for a foul. Real Sociedad earn a free kick.
13' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
13' Mallorca have a goal ruled out for offside!
12' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Real Sociedad.
11' Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
11' The Mallorca players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
2' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) tackles a bit over-zealously and Jose Munuera blows for a foul. A free kick to Real Sociedad.
1' The match has just started.
Mallorca will kick-off.
